definitions.gloss: made of leather; leather (as a material attribute)
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is manufactured from leather. Used as a modifier before nouns to describe the material of bags, shoes, belts, and other items.

examples.japanese: {革製|かわせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦かばん→かばん：00637_kaban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{革製|かわせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I've been using this leather wallet for ten years.

examples.japanese: {革製|かわせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{長持|ながも}ち→長持ち：14474_nagamochi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Leather shoes last a long time if you take care of them.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧ (leather; hide) and ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (made of; manufactured). The suffix ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ is highly productive and attaches to materials to indicate what something is made from.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {革製|かわせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧: leather shoes
- {革製|かわせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧: leather wallet
- {革製|かわせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ベルト→ベルト：01508_beruto⟧: leather belt
- {革製|かわせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ソファー→ソファー：05607_sofaa⟧: leather sofa
- {革製|かわせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧: leather gloves

OTHER {製|せい} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧: made of wood
- ⟦{金属製|きんぞくせい}→金属製：28457_kinzokusei⟧: made of metal
- {紙製|かみせい}: made of paper
- {布製|ぬのせい}: made of cloth
- ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of plastic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- レザー: leather — the loanword, often used in fashion contexts and brand names
- ⟦{本革|ほんがわ}→本革：16787_hongawa⟧: genuine leather — distinguishes real leather from synthetic
- {合皮|ごうひ}/⟦{合成皮革|ごうせいひかく}→合成皮革：23705_gouseihikaku⟧: synthetic leather; faux leather — the artificial alternative
